notes: Identity verified from the readable Macquarie University cover: title Morphological processing in the flankers task; authors Grainger, Snell, and Beyersmann; DOI 10.1080/23273798.2020.1810292. Cover describes an Accepted Manuscript published online 21/08/2020 and cites the 2021 volume 36(3), 288–295, consistent with the supplied 2020 online-publication reference. This is an author manuscript, not a secondary article or preregistration. The remaining canonical text has pervasive corrupted glyph/control-character encoding. No local PDF is named in the assigned input; the source URL in the cover was not acquired under the cache-only instruction. All seven rows provide the same broad description and p.4 locator without a named contrast, outcome, or test distinguishing them. No target was assigned by row order or numeric matching. The corrupted body cannot establish analytic N, coefficient, or same-test p bound. This is unresolved evidence, not a finding that the article omits these statistics. No numeric candidates can be read reliably; no N was inferred from recruitment totals or degrees of freedom and no effect-size conversion was performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
